text:
olivia: Uploaded a compact 'mini header' mock for the Playground. Key changes: streaming transcript now flows under a slim header, Stop / Regenerate moved into header right area, token rail collapsed into a single icon that expands on hover, prompt library quick-insert button next to composer. Screenshot: https://redwood.mock/mini-header.png (alt: 'mini header with token icon and header controls').
kevin: Love the space saving. Concern: moving Stop/Regenerate to the header might hurt discoverability. Most users look for controls near the input.
maria: Agree with kevin. Maybe we keep a small sticky Stop near the stream and put Regenerate in the header. Or show composer-local Stop on hover only.
diego: Accessibility note: streaming content should use aria-live="polite" by default so SRs aren't interrupted. We should also provide an explicit Pause control so screen-reader users can stop live updates and read the response. Use aria-live="off" while paused.
ux-bot: A11y checklist: keyboard focus order must include token meter, prompt library, and Stop. Collapsed token icon must have aria-label (e.g., "token usage: 45 tokens"). Ensure contrast meets AA.
sam: Token counter UX: live-updating every token is distracting. Debounce updates to ~250ms and show an interim state (ellipsis). Also capture final and peak token counts post-generation.
olivia: Debounce 200-300ms sounds good. UX question: should the collapsed token icon show a hover preview of recent token breakdown? feels noisy; leaning no.
kevin: I drafted keyboard flow: Tab -> Prompt library -> Composer -> Send/Stop. If Stop is only in the header this breaks flow. Option: duplicate Stop (header + composer) and keep Regenerate in header-only.
maria: Copy choice: 'Stop' vs 'Pause' — Pause suggests resume. We want both: Pause to temporarily halt streaming for reading (SR) and Stop to cancel generation.
diego: SR suggestion: announce when streaming completes: "Response complete — X tokens used" via a role="status" live region. Expose Pause with aria-pressed state.
olivia: Dev note: CSS for token badge: `.token-badge{ min-width:34px; font-size:12px }` and fallbacks for high contrast.
sam: Prompt library quick-insert must be keyboard accessible with aria-haspopup and aria-expanded. Support drag+drop into composer, plus a one-key insert shortcut.
maria: :thumbsup: Let's schedule a 6-person usability session next Tue/Wed focused on discoverability and SR flows.
olivia: I'll set that up. Action items: (1) Debounce token updates to 250ms (sam), (2) Add SR Pause control + completion announcement (diego), (3) Duplicate Stop in composer behind FF (kevin), (4) Update a11y checklist and docs (maria).
kevin: I'll open a PR with the header layout and a feature-flagged composer Stop.
maria: Mobile nit: token icon must not overlap send button; on mobile it should become a bottom-left floating action icon.
olivia: Copy tweak: change hover text from 'Prompt library' to 'Insert prompt' to reduce ambiguity.
diego: I'll add ARIA examples and code snippets for pause/resume states in the a11y doc.
sam: Will post a GIF prototype of the debounced live counter and token hover expand later today.
olivia: Thanks all :rocket:
